item.title: Fly Tipping Christchurch Way, 24th July
item.description:
While I am grateful that the council has conducted litter picking and street cleaning in the area, it has left the bags of rubbish on the street corner of Christchurch Way and Mauritius Road for over 1.5 weeks. There is now a huge collection of rubbish that is smelling, rotting in the heat and attracting flys and other animals. The bags are also now being ripped open. This is also very unsanitary to walk past and feeds into the ‘broken widow’ theory. The council would fine a member of the public for fly tipping offences if they left this rubbish on the street corner and so this does not feel fair. Even more frustratingly, this is a huge inefficiency in the use of council funds. Money is being spent on litter picking and street cleaning, and the processes are not in place for this rubbish to be disposed off and so it creates dirtier streets than before the cleaning. The council should be better responsible for tax payers funds.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Mauritius Road, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
